Winslow Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Expedia Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.67 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.44% or $1.6 during the last trading session, reaching $109.77. About 1.43 million shares traded. Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE) has declined 17.38% since April 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.93% the S&P500.
